maml:description.maml:para: A wrapper around Start-Transcript with a default path to the "My Documents" and an automatic date/time stamp on the transcript file.

Creates a session transcript in the path specified using a standard file name. Default is to append if the transcript file already exists (-Append) and include the timestamp each command was run (-IncludeInvocationHeader).

maml:description.maml:para: Tests if the data passed is in a valid datetime format and returns true/false.
Uses Get-Date to test the format and try/catch to prevent a bad format from generating an exception in the console.

maml:alert.maml:para:
The $Date paramater data type is cast to a string so that Get-Date won't interpret an integer as legal format specifying the number of ticks past the earliest system time.
Written to support the Move-mVMToDecomFolderAndUpdateNote
